family.ex: Where are you headed after the site visit?
family.ar: إنت رايح فين بعد زيارة الموقع؟
family.ex2: If you're headed downtown, take the invoice to the bank.

syn.note: neutral, general; can sound more final

ctx: I'm heading out now. The quotation for the bank is on the shared drive if they call before tomorrow.
ctx_ar: أنا ماشي دلوقتي. عرض السعر بتاع البنك على الدرايف المشترك لو كلموا قبل بكرة.

family.ex: Take it slow when you explain the tender to the client.

family.ex2: He isn't technical, so avoid jargon.

family.ex: Could you slow down a little? I'm writing the battery specs.

family.ex2: Thanks, now I have all the numbers.

family.ex: Please speak slowly; the line from China is bad.
family.ar: ياريت تتكلم بالراحة؛ الخط من الصين وحش.
family.ex2: Speaking slowly helps both of us.

syn.note: no rush; finish when you're ready

syn.ex2: Take your time; we sign on Sunday.
syn.ar2: خد وقتك؛ هنمضي يوم الحد.

syn.note: short, informal; tells someone there's no hurry

syn.ex2: No rush, but please don't forget the photos.

ctx: Raj was nervous before his call with the supplier in India. His manager said, 'Take it slow, and ask them to repeat if needed.'

family.ar: الزحمة في مدينة نصر أخّرت الفني ساعة.
family.ex2: Next time he'll leave earlier for that client.
family.ar2: المرة الجاية هيمشي بدري للعميل ده.

ctx: I apologize for being late; I was caught in traffic on the Ring Road. Shall we start with the UPS quotation?

syn.note: short contact to see how things are

syn.note: longer talk to share all recent news

syn.ex2: We have a lot to catch up on.
syn.ar2: عندنا حاجات كتير نتكلم فيها.

ant.ar: ماتسيبش التواصل مع العملاء بعد ما الضمان يخلص.
ant.ex2: We lost touch with one bank, and it cost us the renewal.
ant.ar2: انقطع تواصلنا مع بنك، وده خسّرنا التجديد.

ctx_ar: هتواصل مع مهندس المستشفى بكرة. عايز أأكد ميعاد الفصل لترقية الـ‎UPS‎.

quiz.ar: خلّينا نقعد نتكلم بعد المراجعة؛ عندنا أخبار كتير.

book: "Touch base" is a common business idiom.

family.ex: I'll check in with the client after the battery change.
